messages:
alex: heads-up — snyk popped a few findings for services talking to auth: grpc-go, golang.org/x/oauth2, and a net/http TLS pattern in token-service. anyone able to triage? :eyes:

priya: on it. quick summary from vuln-bot + initial look: grpc has a malformed-frame panic (CVE-2026-XXXX), oauth2 has a token refresh race (CVE-2026-YYYY), and net/http client can leak connections in certain handshake edgecases (CVE-2026-ZZZZ). Affects token-service + auth-proxy. Impact: medium, exploit complexity moderate.

sam: are there vendor patches? can we pin and make a focused hotfix for token-service first?

priya: yes — upstream released fixes. suggested minimal changes for token-service go.mod: 

```go
module github.com/redwoodinc/token-service

go 1.20

require (
  google.golang.org/grpc v1.57.0
  golang.org/x/oauth2 v0.10.0
)
```

Then run: `go get google.golang.org/grpc@v1.57.0 golang.org/x/oauth2@v0.10.0 && go mod tidy` and run unit + integration smoke. Avoid `replace` unless absolutely necessary.

jules: P1 for token-service (auth critical path), P2 for gateway (edge), P3 for background services. Create security branch + PR, add audit log entry for the patch. KMS integration appears unaffected but please confirm there are no changed KMS call sites. :point_up:

vuln-bot: Automated summary: CVE-2026-XXXX (grpc-go) — panic on malformed frames; CVE-2026-YYYY (x/oauth2) — token refresh race condition; CVE-2026-ZZZZ (net/http) — connection leak/DoS. Patches released upstream.

alex: opened PR: https://github.com/redwoodinc/token-service/pull/228 — bumped grpc + oauth2, ran unit tests + staging integration. CI green except one timeout in auth_test.go (flaky). Tagging `hotfix/security-2026-03-14`. :shipit:

sam: plan for rollout: canary to 5% for 1 hour, watch latency + 5xxs, then 25% for 30m, then full. Alert threshold: errors > 0.5% -> rollback and notify incidents. Also verify metrics from KV cache and KV-store latency (just in case).

priya: note on pinning strategy: prefer explicit `require` updates and bump module minimums. Do NOT commit long-term `replace` directives. If a backport is needed, document and remove after upstream merges. Run `govulncheck` + `gosec` locally before merge.

jules: assign rollout owner -> alex. ETA cut: tomorrow 10:00 PST. Add audit event `security.patch.applied` with PR URL, CVE refs, and operator. Also update the security tracker ticket.

alex: ack. will push canary tonight and post metrics here. linking the PR with the audit entry now. :white_check_mark:

sam: follow-up: create a ticket for repository-level module policy — weekly `govulncheck` in CI, minimum supported versions table, and an ops-runbook for dependency hotfixes.

priya: adding RFC draft to the backlog for module pinning & upgrade policy. will include guidance on `go` directive, `require` semantics, and avoid `replace`.

alex: updated thread with canary results after deploy — initial metrics look stable, small drop in median p50 latency, no increase in 5xx. will keep monitoring. :eyes:
